name: Harukanaru Toki no Naka de: Ryuuguu no Miko
original_name: 遙かなる時空の中で 龍宮の神子
source:
The protagonist (Yuikawa Akari), is a college student in modern world and went on ferry trip with her friend. When the ferry is sailing over Dan no Ura, A storm came and countless of monster appeared from the sky.

A man with graceful kimono came to protect the protagonist from the monster, carrying her into the depth of the ocean
"I am Kiyomori, in the name of Heike clan I will guide the princess"

He guided the protagonist to the city of underwater called "Ryuuguu" , ruled by Ryuujin and chosen as its priestess. With the Hachiyou, who are the chosen heroes whose name engraved in history, the protagonist began her journey to save the spacetime. 

[Translated from [url=https://www.gamecity.ne.jp/haruka-ryugu/]official website[/url]]
translation:
主人公（结川灯）是一名现代女大学生，与好友一同乘渡轮出游。当渡轮驶经坛之浦海面时，暴风雨骤然袭来，无数怨灵怪物自天空中现身。

一位身着华美和服的男子赶来护住主人公免受怪物侵袭，并抱起她跃入深海之中：
“吾名清盛，谨以平家之名，为神子引路。”

他将主人公带往由龙神统治的水中都城“龙宫”，而她也在此被选为龙神的神子。与青史留名的天选英雄“八叶”一道，主人公踏上了拯救时空的旅途。

[译自[url=https://www.gamecity.ne.jp/haruka-ryugu/]官方网站[/url]]
